name: Iwasaki Tousuke
source:
A young man studying electricity at Keio University after being fascinated by its splendor when he saw it in New York.
A man of his word, he dislikes irrational things. At first glance, he appears to be a calm person. Surprisingly, he also has a passionate side.
It seems he has some past history with a Mononoke.....

Note that he only has a route in the vita port of Meiji Tokyo Renka.
